title: Curable resin composition containing fine polymeric particles with improved bond strength against impact chipping
abstract: A curable resin composition comprising 100 parts by mass of an epoxy resin (A), 1 to 100 parts by mass of fine polymer particles {B), and 1 to 100 parts by mass of a blocked urethane (C), wherein the fine polymeric particles have a core-shell structure of a core layer and a shell layer, the core layer comprising diene rubber, the shell layer comprising at least one hydroxyl group, and the content of the group Hydroxyl of the fine polymeric particles (B) is from 0.01 to 0.8 mmol / g.
